slides.narration: In this part of Chapter 20, use 20.1.2 Modeling Application Data as an engineering claim, not a vocabulary word. A Record groups identifier, name, and quantity. Inventory owns a vector of records and controls insertion. Callers can inspect the records through a const reference but cannot directly mutate the vector through the public interface. The identifier, rather than the display name, determines uniqueness. This representation favors simple insertion and listing for a small bounded collection. A linear duplicate search is adequate under the 100-record teaching limit. Book III later evaluates maps and indexing when lookup requirements change. Do not add a hash table merely to look advanced; choose complexity in proportion to the workload and keep the invariant easy to inspect. slides.title: 20.2.1 Dividing Responsibilities Across Classes and Functions
keyPoints: The inventory library validates records and owns accepted state.
The command loop parses one line at a time, ensuring that a failed command does not leave a stream in a confusing.
Reporting is a separate function that formats existing records without changing them.
Parsing produces a local candidate record.
slides.narration: In this part of Chapter 20, use 20.2.1 Dividing Responsibilities Across Classes and Functions as an engineering claim, not a vocabulary word. The inventory library validates records and owns accepted state. The command loop parses one line at a time, ensuring that a failed command does not leave a stream in a confusing partially consumed state for the next command. Reporting is a separate function that formats existing records without changing them. Parsing produces a local candidate record. Only a fully parsed command is passed to the inventory. The library then validates domain rules before committing the insertion. This creates two boundaries: text syntax and domain validity. A command can be syntactically valid while still attempting a duplicate identifier, and those cases should remain distinguishable in tests. The graduate-level move is to ask what evidence would make the claim trustworthy: a compiler diagnostic, a runtime value, a preserved invariant, or a boundary that failed cleanly. slides.narration: In this part of Chapter 20, use Evidence and interpretation as an engineering claim, not a vocabulary word. Distinguish the application’s demonstration self-test from the external regression suite. The no-argument mode runs a small set of built-in checks. External cases exercise command sessions and can test error messages and recovery behavior without modifying the application. The expanded package also supplies direct domain regression checks, including the capacity boundary and state preservation after rejected candidates. Passing these finite tests establishes the observed behaviors for the tested builds and cases. It does not establish durable storage, protection from malicious input of arbitrary size, simultaneous access by multiple users, or compatibility with every compiler. The verification report records the actual environment and exclusions. slides.narration: In this part of Chapter 20, use Review and solution notes as an engineering claim, not a vocabulary word. Why separate parsing from domain validation? Parsing establishes whether a line expresses a candidate operation. Domain validation establishes whether that operation is permitted for the current inventory. Different adapters can then share one authoritative rule boundary. Does a const vector reference make retained element references permanent? No. It restricts ordinary mutation through that reference, but element lifetime and invalidation still depend on the owning vector’s operations and destruction. Does a successful session exit mean every add succeeded? No. Interactive command rejection is reported within the session while the program continues. question.prompt: What three things must you account for after the run?
question.answer: Account for stdout, stderr, and exit status. For this exercise, stdout should match the expected text, stderr should be empty, and exit status should be 0.

checks.prompt: Why is empty stderr worth saying out loud?
checks.answer: Because it proves normal results are not being smuggled through the diagnostic channel; many automated tests and scripts distinguish stdout from stderr.

checks.prompt: How should you explain exit code 0?
checks.answer: It is the process-level success signal. It does not replace checking stdout; it only says the program finished without reporting process failure.
